SMTO-PSM-0013 — A parameter needs at least one value before saving

GUID: 44f15155-4ea9-46ad-b9a6-a9015e60e03c
Slug: parameter-value-invalid
Domain: PSM · Subsystem: psm

What happened

  • SMTO can't save a parameter with an empty value. The parameter was not saved or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Parameter Store, open the parameter's Value tab and add at least one named field, for example {"token": "your-token"}, instead of empty braces {}. A parameter with no fields has nothing for SMTO to use, so it refuses to save it.
  2. If you only have a piece of text to store, select FREE FORM, type the text, then select Save. FREE FORM saves your text as a value, so the parameter isn't empty.
  3. If you only meant to change the name, description or tags, select Hide next to the value, make those edits, then select Save. When the value is hidden, SMTO keeps the saved value exactly as it is.

What success looks like

  • Parameter Store shows Saved and the parameter keeps a value.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't include your secret values in the message.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Parameter create/update validation rejected a supplied value_json that is empty or not an object.

What this means

  • Parameter value create/update validation receives a non-object or an empty object for a supplied value_json. Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.

Why this can happen

  • Parameter value create/update validation receives a non-object or an empty object for a supplied value_json.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect value_json separately from context_json, which has different emptiness rules.

How to fix it

  • Supply a non-empty JSON object for value_json (validators value_must_be_object and value_update_must_be_object in src/agent_runtime/parameters/models.py). On update, omit value_json entirely to keep the stored value instead of sending {}.
  • Supply a nonempty JSON object for value_json before saving.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended nonempty value object passes creation/update validation.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
